maxSearchTime.description: Maximum time to run the search, in minutes (total time including any nested searches).

maxTrials.description: Upper bound on total hyperparameter sets that we are evaluating during the search.

maxConcurrentTrials.description: Upper bound on total hyperparameter sets that we are evaluating in parallel during the search.

numAutoRecoveryAttempts.description: If value is greater than 0, failed trials of hpo experiment will be attempted for recovery.

title:
Execution constraints for {@link Hpo.ExperimentBase}, provided as part of {@link Hpo.Spec} setting the time taken
and number of trials. Also determines the number of concurrent trials.
name: Hpo.ExecutionConstraint
